structured.answer: I'd go with what the page marks as "הזול": open an investment account at פסגות and buy the קרן מחקה "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" with the 0.02% fee. It shows 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, and the other ones I looked at come out lower. I'm fairly sure, but the page didn't use my real amounts and I don't know פסגות as a broker.

stuck.where: Sliders at the top (סכום היום 10,000, הפקדה חודשית 500)
stuck.why: My amount is 30,000 ₪, not 10,000. The page answered for someone else's numbers and I didn't try to drag a slider to get exactly 30,000 on my phone.

stuck.where: Comparison box: 'זוג הבא בתור 86,449 ₪, −43 ₪ לעומת הבחירה שלכם'
stuck.why: Same fund at a different place, only 43 ₪ apart. So does the account even matter? I couldn't tell what 'זוג' means.
A dark grey popup ('מס רווח במכירה') covered part of the fund list and I couldn't read what was under it.

stuck.where: Bottom of the fund list: '−23,766 ₪ בין +2,212 ₪ ל'
stuck.why: A huge minus and a range. It scared me off that fund (מנוטרלת מט"ח) and I didn't get why it's so different.

used: Big heading 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן'
Fund card: ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), דמי ניהול 0.02%
Account card: פסגות ניירות ערך (פסגות טרייד), 1,057 ₪ over 10 years
Right-hand list: פסגות first at 86,492, לאומי 83,396, then the rest lower
Bar 'כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים': 6,876 ₪, mostly the pink part
Shekel numbers on the left of the fund list (−213, −447, −1,268, −3,671 etc.)
Table on screen 4: 10 vs 12 שנים gives 19,116 ₪ more
skimmed: Legend under the cost bar (I guessed pink 'מס' was the big part)
Fund tags like צוברת, עסקה חוזרת, חשיפה לדולר
Bottom of the bank list (מזרחי, אלטשולר, אקסלנס, מיטב)
Line chart 'מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם'
Screen 4: currency-hedge section with the big percents (−21.8% ב־2022)
skipped: Small grey line with the exchange rate 3.16 and the date
'למה חלק מהקרנות בלי מחיר בפסגות' notes
Foreign ETFs with IE00... codes and 'אין מחיר כאן'
Year-by-year table and the small-print paragraph at the bottom of screen 4
Screens 5 and 6, I stopped before them
unsure_meaning: the red minus numbers on the left of the fund list: is that lost money or just the gap from the cheapest?
pink 'מס' in the bar: did I guess right that it's tax?
not_found: A place to set my own 30,000 ₪ that I'd trust myself to hit with a slider
A simple 'what to do first' step, like how to open the account
Whether my pension or קרן השתלמות could do this instead

findings.what: Default amounts are 10,000 ₪ + 500 a month. The big 70,000 → 86,492 numbers aren't my situation, but they stuck in my head anyway.
A popup ('מס רווח במכירה') floats over the fund list and hides rows
Long lists of red minus shekel numbers with no clear label telling me what they're measured against
findings.where: Screen 2, left column of the fund list

findings.what: Too many tags on each fund (עסקה חוזרת, צוברת, חשיפה לדולר...), all colourful and none I understand
The cost bar's colours are explained only in a tiny legend underneath. I had to guess which colour is tax and which is fees.
findings.where: Screen 1, 'כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים'

findings.what: The cheapest account (פסגות) is fine, but some of the cheaper-looking brokers lower down are names I don't know
The hedged fund shows a scary range (−23,766 ₪ to +2,212 ₪) with no simple explanation next to it
findings.where: Screen 3, top of the fund list

findings.what: The page is very long and dense after the first screen, and I was bored by the line chart
